description.id: Panel web untuk mengelola database MySQL dan MariaDB

module_files.app/config.inc.php:
<?php

// CheesEnv keeps the editable configuration in its config folder.
require <<<'CHEESENV'
{{conf}}/config.inc.php
CHEESENV;

config_templates.config.inc.php:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

/*
 * phpMyAdmin configuration generated by CheesEnv.
 * Servers come from panel.json, which CheesEnv rewrites on every start with
 * the installed MySQL services (host and port only, never passwords).
 */

$cheesenvPanelFile = <<<'CHEESENV'
{{run}}/panel.json
CHEESENV;
$cheesenvPanel = json_decode((string) @file_get_contents($cheesenvPanelFile), true);
if (!is_array($cheesenvPanel)) {
    $cheesenvPanel = [];
}

$i = 0;
foreach ($cheesenvPanel['targets'] ?? [] as $target) {
    $i++;
    $cfg['Servers'][$i]['verbose'] = (($target['name'] ?? '') === 'mariadb' ? 'MariaDB ' : 'MySQL ') . $target['version'];
    $cfg['Servers'][$i]['host'] = (string) $target['host'];
    $cfg['Servers'][$i]['port'] = (string) $target['port'];
    $cfg['Servers'][$i]['auth_type'] = 'cookie';
    $cfg['Servers'][$i]['AllowNoPassword'] = false;
}

// A fresh 32-byte key per start: restarting the panel signs everyone out.
$cfg['blowfish_secret'] = hex2bin((string) ($cheesenvPanel['token'] ?? '')) ?: '';

$cfg['TempDir'] = <<<'CHEESENV'
{{run}}
CHEESENV;
$cfg['VersionCheck'] = false;
$cfg['SendErrorReports'] = 'never';
$cfg['ShowPhpInfo'] = false;
$cfg['UploadDir'] = '';
$cfg['SaveDir'] = '';
config_templates.php.ini:
memory_limit = 512M
upload_max_filesize = 128M
post_max_size = 128M
max_execution_time = 300
display_errors = Off
log_errors = On
error_log = "{{logs}}/phpmyadmin-{{version}}-php.log"
date.timezone = UTC
expose_php = Off
session.save_path = "{{run}}"
session.use_strict_mode = 1
session.cookie_httponly = 1
session.cookie_samesite = Strict
opcache.enable_cli = 1
config_templates.router.php:
<?php

// Router for PHP's built-in server: phpMyAdmin internals are never served.
$cheesenvPath = preg_replace('#[\\\\/]+#', '/', rawurldecode(strtok($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] ?? '/', '?') ?: '/'));
$cheesenvDenied = str_contains($cheesenvPath, '..');
// Windows ignores trailing dots/spaces in names ("libraries./" is "libraries/").
$cheesenvPath = preg_replace('#/+#', '/', preg_replace('#[. ]+(?=/|$)#', '', $cheesenvPath));
if ($cheesenvDenied
    || preg_match('#^/(setup|libraries|vendor|templates|sql|test|tmp|config\.inc\.php|composer\.(json|lock))(/|$)#i', $cheesenvPath)) {
    http_response_code(403);
    echo 'Forbidden';
    return true;
}
return false;
